subject.title: feat(ui): redesign cron page as sidebar-first Automations master-detail

question: Should the Automations master-detail redesign, including default sidebar pinning and retirement of the quick-create wizard, become the canonical Control UI cron experience?
rationale: This protected, broad feature changes a primary workflow and navigation defaults; correctness repairs cannot decide whether maintainers want the product direction itself.

options.title: Adopt after blockers
options.body: Accept the redesign after the three compatibility defects, branch conflicts, and real-behavior proof gap are resolved.

options.title: Narrow the redesign
options.body: Retain the current cron workflow and land only selected navigation or layout improvements.

options.title: Do not adopt
options.body: Close the paired proposal and PR if the existing cron experience should remain canonical.

recommendation.title: Adopt after blockers
recommendation.body: Accept the redesign after the three compatibility defects, branch conflicts, and real-behavior proof gap are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main feature-history owner across the affected cron UI, navigation, and settings surfaces and authored the paired direction proposal.
